note: Hand-authored world-1 teaching boards (SPEC §2). The bake solver-verifies each and copies it to the front of world 1.

levels.name: One Wall
levels.teaches: Tap the mason, tap the wall. One break reaches the keep.

levels.name: Outside In
levels.teaches: The timber is sealed inside the stone. Break the outer wall first, then the inner one opens to you.

levels.name: The Wrong Wall
levels.teaches: One mason. Spend it on the outer stone and the inner stone is out of reach forever. The axemen go first.
